upstream.architecture: DeepLSD inference model with official normal filtering parameters

asset.runtime_serialization: safetensors state dict converted once from the trusted original checkpoint

execution.isolation: one spawned child process per image, with a 45-second result timeout
execution.queue_safety: parent reads the result queue before waiting for the child, preventing dense-line queue backpressure deadlock
execution.runtime_pickle_policy: not permitted; the P0 backend accepts only .safetensors weights

decision.reason: The official DeepLSD backend is resource-contained and reproducible, but it localizes fewer injected projective-line targets and produces substantially more clean-image review candidates than the frozen OpenCV-LSD reference.
decision.scope: This evaluates P0 review-candidate localization on paired real-image line edits; it does not estimate AI-origin classification accuracy.
